comments_sample.author: @murymailnan6800
comments_sample.text: Ronnie Radke, you are a great artist, but also an incredible actor. It will be a pleasure to watch you play in a movie. Respect.

comments_sample.author: @jgillispie05
comments_sample.text: This is probably a $5-$10M production. Insane.

comments_sample.author: @TaraDactylll
comments_sample.text: Ronnie’s vision is unlike any other artist I’ve ever seen. This band is incredibly talented and I’m proud to have been around for so long to see them evolve into something that leaves us speechless.

comments_sample.author: @Rogue_Templar
comments_sample.text:
The are no words known to man throughout all history that can explain just how epic this track and the video are, both are biblical.

I only came across you and this track last night by chance. The chills and goosebumps are off the scale. I was genuinely mesmerised. I am now a fan.

You sir are astounding and so is your team.

comments_sample.author: @Sheriff_GDC
comments_sample.text: Remember, life is like a video game
